resources.string: Run the Freebuff coding agent natively in Termux — no proot, no second userland.
Termux is not installed. Install it first; this app only handles setup.

Setup runs in Termux, where you can watch it. The command is shown before anything runs.
You may need Termux\'s \"allow external apps\" setting for this app to send commands: add allow-external-apps=true to ~/.termux/termux.properties.

Termux will download and install:
• the freebuff-native package (~30 KB) from a signed APT repository, • the glibc runtime it needs (~400 MB installed, glibc packages from the termux-glibc repository), • the official Freebuff release (~136 MB) from GitHub, verified against the sha256 published with it.
Nothing is uploaded. Use Wi-Fi if mobile data is metered. You can cancel now and run the same steps by hand later.

Termux only accepts commands from other apps when this is enabled in its own settings:
allow-external-apps=true
Add that line to ~/.termux/termux.properties inside Termux, then run termux-reload-settings (or restart Termux), and try again. The command is copied to the clipboard for you.
This app does not install Freebuff by itself: it starts the setup in Termux. Install Termux from F-Droid, then come back.
